review_type: Independent AI-assisted static source and exact candidate review; not qualified external biological review.

source_verification.source_hash_convention: Decoded-object SHA-256 and Git-framed SHA-1 checked separately from API response hashes. Text anchors hash exact original byte lines including original endings; notebook anchors use joined stored cell source with line endings retained; article paragraph uses UTF-8 joined itertext without normalization. The search-result hash covers local tool-response JSON serialization, not upstream HTTP bytes.

scientific_review.competition_row_multiplicity: The inspected group-by/mutate/select sequence preserves retained clone/run rows. The conditional empirical-distribution identity is valid for a nonempty eligible Lauer subset under the stated common selector. Actual multiplicities, group contributions and numerical effects remain unmeasured.
scientific_review.units: The code and article literally divide hourly-regression coefficients by ln(2). The stated conditional relation k_g=k_h/nu assumes the same declared response and g=nu*t. Neither nu nor a corrected published coefficient was inferred from the approximate assay duration.
scientific_review.barcode_identity: The notebook authenticates an author-provided bc04/bc01 alias statement, a four-column filter and possible low-count aggregate row. Numerical outputs and later positional barcode labels still require actual mapping records.
scientific_review.upstream_classification: Finite adaptive-minus-neutral likelihood values determine the source classification and neutral zeroing. The later positive selector can inherit that model decision; it is not a separately calibrated significance test or direct mutation-origin observation.
scientific_review.notebook_outputs: Stored display values are not admitted as authenticated current counts, a source replay or a publication-execution record.
scientific_review.validation_boundary: The 2022 study reuses 2018 evolution populations. Experimental fitness comparisons do not independently confirm the inferred formation rate. Unmatched CNV joins do not establish DNA-negative truth.
scientific_review.reported_uncertainty: Intermediate nonbarcoded interval scaling is described without asserting an erroneous published estimate or interval; exported fitness tables omit uncertainty columns.
scientific_review.licensing: The actual inspected software license is MIT. Separate OSF data terms remain unverified; neither MIT nor article CC BY 4.0 is transferred automatically.
scientific_review.privacy_and_scope: Seven payloads contain original analysis and selected identities, without raw code/article/notebook bodies, biological datasets, author contacts, private workspace paths or credentials.

scientific_non_admissions: No actual clone rows, clone/run counts, 29-versus-28 reconciliation, missingness reason or numerical source result was authenticated.
No source-author code execution, simulation, biological fit, new theorem, independent native origin/establishment observation or native matched W/A/M admission occurred.
Methods 0.6.0 remains unchanged; no new Zenodo version is justified.
scope: Exact seven-file source package accepted. Integrated working-tree, immutable committed-head, website preservation and deployment evidence require separate review.
